description.text: The four year (full time) program provides students with the opportunity to study in areas that are of particular relevance to the business management and conduct of internatinal business ,such as Business Chinese ,China's Economy,World Economy ,Micro-economics,Macro-economies ,Management,Marketing Reseach,International Communication and Busniess Negotiation ,Marketing ,International Trade Practice and Operation ,International Business Law ,International Ecnomic Cooperation ,International Trade Theory and Policy ,National Market and National Ecnomy,International Finance ,Logistics and Port Economy ,International Business Etiquette and China's Investment Envirnment etc. This program is set for those whose native language is not Chinese .Bachelor degree will be conferred to those students have fulfilled the stipulated curriculum ,acquired 120 credits ,and past HSK Band 4. Applicants with IELTS score above 5.0 are eligible.

duration.text: The International Economy and Trade at Zhejiang Wanli University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1388 USD/per semester ￥ 10000 CNY/per semester

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3or above 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Graduation certificate of high school Gradution certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not,it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.

requirements.text: Applicant is under the age of 25, and is in good health, high-school graduate with good marks. The HSK score should reach level 3 or above
